unguarded-framed-rule: error[krs::analysis::always-enabled-rule]: rule `burn` is always enabled, so execution never terminates: it leaves the computation cell out, every cell pattern is a variable or `_` of the cell's sort, and it has no requires guard
identity-framed-rule: error[krs::analysis::rule-changes-no-cell]: rule `idle` changes no cell: every cell it names keeps its content and it leaves the computation cell out, so applying it changes nothing
group-and-leaf: error[krs::analysis::group-and-descendant]: rule `peek` selects the nested cell `frame` and the cell `pc` inside it; the whole-cell entry `frame` already names every cell below it, so select one or the other
reused-cell-declaration: error[krs::analysis::ambiguous-cell-sort]: cell declaration `Frame` is the content of more than one cell field (`current`, `saved`), so its K cell sort is ambiguous; declare one struct per nested cell
group-literal: error[krs::syntax::invalid-state-macro]: invalid `cells!` payload: nested cell entries are a binder, `_`, or fragment!
cell-bag: error[krs::syntax::invalid-cell-attribute]: invalid `cell` attribute: cell bags are unsupported by K's LLVM and Haskell backends; use cell_type = "Set", "Map", or "List"
collection-without-type: error[krs::syntax::invalid-cell-attribute]: invalid `cell` attribute: a `multiplicity = "*"` collection needs `cell_type = "Set"`, `"Map"`, or `"List"`
collection-siblings: error[krs::analysis::collection-siblings]: the collection cell `job` shares its parent with other cells; K requires a `multiplicity = "*"` cell to be its parent's only child, so give it a `#[k::cell]` struct of its own
optional-plain-field: error[krs::syntax::unsupported-configuration-field]: unsupported fixed configuration field: a `multiplicity = "?"` cell is declared `Option<T>`, T its leaf sort or nested cell struct
optional-without-multiplicity: error[krs::syntax::unsupported-configuration-field]: unsupported fixed configuration field: an Option field is an optional cell: add `multiplicity = "?"` to its `#[k::cell(..)]`
optional-none-template: error[E0599]: no associated function or constant named `__krs_initializer_payload` found for struct `Machine` in the current scope
error[krs::syntax::unsupported-initializer-body]: unsupported declarative initializer body: K needs a template for a `?` cell; write Some(<template>) and add `initial` if the cell starts present
unknown-instance-label: error[krs::analysis::unknown-instance-label]: `..ghost` names no instance of `job` labelled `ghost @` in the pattern
list-braces: error[krs::analysis::collection-entry]: List collections are positional: write `job: [ .. ]`, with instances at the front before `..` and at the back after it
list-both-ends: error[krs::analysis::collection-entry]: this entry names instances at both ends of the List collection `job`; a KRS rule changes either the front (before `..`) or the back (after it), so split it into two rules
map-created-without-key: error[krs::analysis::map-collection-key]: a new instance of the Map collection `job` states its key: write `id: ..`, its first child

optional-config-var: warning[krs::analysis::collection-config-var-without-initial]: the `multiplicity = "?"` cell `counter` reads a configuration variable, so K starts it present although it is not `initial`; add `initial` to say so

warning[CellCollectionVarWithoutInitial]: Configuration variable found in declaration of collection cell <counter>. Implicitly, this causes the initial configuration to start with one <counter> element instead of zero. Add the `initial=""` attribute to make that behavior explicit.
